description: Primary sources a critical may cite. A host matches exactly, or with a leading 'www.'; other subdomains do not match, because forums and community sites on these domains carry user-written posts. URLs must be https on the default port with no userinfo. A host with 'paths' also restricts the URL path to one pattern: a pattern without '*' is a path prefix that must be followed by at least one more non-empty segment; '*/security/advisories/' matches /<owner>/<repo>/security/advisories/<id> only for an owner listed in 'owners' (case-insensitive), because any repository owner can publish an advisory in their own repository. Paths containing '%', a backslash, an empty segment, or a '.' or '..' segment never match a path pattern. go.dev is path-restricted because it hosts user-shared playground programs, python.org because it hosts user-submitted job listings and community pages.
